topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: Lower antenna efficiency directly impacts link budget by reducing available power, increasing interference, and degrading SNR. This leads to reduced signal strength, increased noise floor, and decreased channel capacity. These factors impact both uplink and downlink performance, requiring higher transmit power and potentially increasing latency.  The resulting degraded link quality necessitates careful consideration of trade-offs between bandwidth and latency.
reference_context: Satellite antenna efficiency directly influences link budget calculations by reducing available power for both transmit and receive. This translates to increased interference, reduced SNR, and degraded channel capacity. To mitigate these challenges, efficient antenna design is crucial to optimizing performance in GEO-LEO satellite communication systems.
